verdict: Meta leads are steady; Google tracking and GBP need immediate repair.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 31 leads entirely through Meta at a cost of $46.49 per lead — that channel is performing. Google Ads, however, spent $2,665.88 over the same window and recorded only 2 conversions; Google Analytics shows zero conversion events, which confirms a tracking break rather than a campaign problem, and that is being repaired now. Separately, your Google Business Profile went silent over the last four days of the period — zero actions from October 1–4 against a healthy 119 for the prior 28 days — and we are actively checking for a listing issue or suppression. Once conversion tracking is restored, Google's true lead count will be visible and spend decisions can be made on real data; the GBP investigation will be resolved this week.
